reason: I would not hand a property-sale lump sum to a company I have never heard of, even with a guarantee. The offer says an AD Category-I bank is the partner but does not name it, and I want to know which bank holds my money.
objection: Which bank actually holds my money while it moves, and can I verify the FINTRAC registration and the partner bank myself? A refund of the fee does not help if the principal goes missing.
would_change_my_mind: A named, big-name partner bank (SBI, HDFC, ICICI or similar) shown up front, a FINTRAC number I can check, and the CA call done before I commit anything. I would probably try a small first transfer to test it.
